# Dirrir Realtor Limited

> Premium real estate agency in Nairobi, Kenya. Part of Rabat Properties Limited.

Dirrir Realtor Limited (DRL) is a verified property agency specialising in homes and
apartments for sale and rent across Nairobi's prime residential neighbourhoods, including
Parklands, Kilimani, Westlands, Lavington, and Riverside. DRL also provides dedicated
services for diaspora investors purchasing Kenyan property from abroad.

## Key Facts

- Trading name: Dirrir Realtor Limited (DRL)
- Parent company: Rabat Properties Limited
- Location: Nairobi, Kenya
- Website: https://www.dirirrealtors.com
- Email: info@dirirrealtors.com
- Tagline: Your Real Estate Professional
- Specialisation: Residential sales, rentals, and diaspora investment in Nairobi

## Services

- **Property Sales** — Apartments, houses, townhouses, and land in Nairobi's prime areas
- **Rentals & Lettings** — Furnished and unfurnished units; short and long-term leases
- **Property Advisory** — Market analysis, neighbourhood comparisons, investment potential reports
- **Diaspora Investment Services** — Virtual property tours, remote transaction management, and scheduled investor updates for clients living abroad
- **Property Management** — Tenant screening, rent collection, maintenance coordination, and lease management

## Areas Served

- Parklands — established multicultural neighbourhood; strong apartment market along 2nd Avenue
- Kilimani — upscale, fast-growing area popular with young professionals and expatriates
- Westlands — Nairobi's business and entertainment hub with premium residential developments
- Lavington — leafy, prestigious suburb favoured by diplomats and senior executives
- Riverside — upmarket enclave along Riverside Drive
- Other Nairobi neighbourhoods including Kileleshwa, Ngong Road corridor, South B & C, and emerging high-growth areas

## About

Dirrir Realtor Limited was founded to make finding a home in Nairobi straightforward,
honest, and rewarding. Every listing is inspected and verified before it is published.
The company serves local buyers, families, relocating professionals, and diaspora
investors building property portfolios in Kenya from the UK, USA, Canada, and the Gulf.
